dedupe_keys.name: tallinn road network graphlet decomposition and extraction code

description: MapTopology publishes graphlet decomposition of Tallinn street-network data derived from the January 2020 OpenStreetMap snapshot. The maraso-TTU repository supplies CSV and ESRI shapefile outputs and a notebook that repeats the extraction for other road networks. Its README explains the input directory, geographic bounding-box selection and export procedure. Python 3.11 and a compiled PyORCA wrapper are documented requirements. The linked Zenodo v2 deposit provides a free archived release under CC BY 4.0; the GitHub repository has no separate licence declaration. Coverage is limited to one network snapshot. Graphlet statistics describe local connectivity, not traffic demand or capacity. Reusing the extraction for another city also requires the corresponding road shapefile and the PyORCA dependency. The code was not executed here. A reviewer-assessed use is selecting structurally comparable road networks for simulation or checking topology before assigning flows. data-openstreetmap is the documented upstream source, while platform-qgis provides a related environment for viewing the geographic outputs.
